strings.name: Linus Torvalds
strings.summary: Linus Torvalds created the Linux kernel as a student and later developed Git for distributed collaboration. He has coordinated kernel maintenance over many years, while its development depends on worldwide community and corporate contributions. Linux is a kernel; Git serves a distinct version-control role.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026, not an exhaustive news record. Institutional achievements are team efforts; announced plans are not completed results.
strings.influence.rationale: Created the Linux kernel and Git, advancing open-source collaboration and global software infrastructure.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Master’s degree in computer science, University of Helsinki
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Linux kernel
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Created and coordinated a kernel underpinning servers, mobile devices and other infrastructure.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Git version control
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Created Git for kernel collaboration; it became a widely used distributed-development tool.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Continued kernel releases
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Released Linux 7.4-rc2, a test release candidate rather than a stable version.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Millennium Technology Prize
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Received the 2012 prize for his open-source operating-system contribution.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Created Git
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Built a distributed version-control system for Linux development.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Focused on kernel maintenance
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Left Transmeta to join Open Source Development Labs.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Joined Transmeta
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Moved to the United States, working on processors while continuing Linux.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Linux 1.0 released
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Worked with contributors to bring the kernel to version 1.0.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Shared Linux publicly
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Shared kernel development and source code while studying in Helsinki.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Entered Helsinki University
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Helsinki
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Born into a Swedish-speaking family in Finland.
